note: The bakery stalls: a woman baker with a brick oven at the back of her stall on the left, a man baker on the right, a fashion-designer shopper. Feminine nouns to the left of the green iron pillar (x=650), masculine to the right. The arch on the far left (seafood counter) goes back to the seafood and deli corner; the arch on the far right leads on to the pastry shop.
